data.name: Dungeon Souls
data.detailed_description:
Dungeon Souls is an action-adventure roguelike dungeon crawler.

Each level is completely procedurally generated so every playthrough is guaranteed to have unique environments and encounters. Search for and activate all the marks placed in each level to unlock the dungeon portal and escape from the Redeemer. Scavenge various items and upgrades to counter the dungeon's dark forces and challenging bosses. You must survive. Hurry.

Dungeon Souls was inspired by Nuclear Throne, Risk of Rain, Overture, BitVenture and Shoot First.




  • Harness the powerful abilities of 10 unique characters
  • Explore a plethora of different environments including dark dungeons, sewers and cathedrals
  • Immerse yourself with deep character progression and permanent skill upgrades
  • Experiment with 50+ unique passive items - Speed boosts, damage buffs, lifesteal bonuses...
  • Battle hordes of dynamic enemies and challenging bosses hell-bent on destroying you

data.short_description: Dungeon Souls is an action-adventure roguelike dungeon crawler which draws heavy inspiration from Nuclear Throne, Risk of Rain, and Overture. Explore vast procedurally generated dungeons, collect loot, and slay hordes of challenging enemies!

reviews.review:
Dungeon Souls is an exciting action roguelike that combines intense dungeon exploration, fast-paced combat, randomized loot, and character progression into a challenging adventure. Developed and published by Lamina Studios, the game embraces the classic appeal of pixel-art dungeon crawlers while incorporating modern roguelike mechanics that encourage experimentation and repeated playthroughs. Its greatest strength lies in creating unpredictable encounters where survival depends on quick reflexes, strategic decisions, and effective character development. Although its presentation appears relatively simple, the gameplay offers surprising depth for players who appreciate demanding action experiences.

The adventure takes place across procedurally generated environments filled with dangerous creatures, valuable equipment, and increasingly difficult encounters. Every dungeon floor introduces randomized layouts that prevent players from relying entirely on memorization. The primary objective involves locating and activating special marks scattered throughout each level to unlock the exit portal. However, escaping is complicated by the presence of the Redeemer, a threatening force that encourages players to move quickly rather than endlessly explore. This mechanic creates an effective balance between risk and reward, as searching for additional resources can improve survival chances while exposing players to greater danger.

Combat is the centerpiece of the experience, delivering frantic encounters that require constant movement and precise attacks. Players face numerous enemies with different behaviors, making positioning and reaction speed essential for survival. The combination of hack-and-slash mechanics and bullet-hell elements creates chaotic battles where dodging incoming attacks becomes just as important as eliminating opponents. Boss encounters further increase the challenge by demanding careful observation and effective use of available abilities. While the difficulty occasionally feels unforgiving, overcoming particularly dangerous situations provides a satisfying sense of achievement.

One of the game's most appealing features is its selection of ten playable characters, each offering unique abilities and different approaches to combat. This diversity encourages experimentation and gives players opportunities to discover fighting styles that complement their preferences. Some character builds favor aggressive attacks, while others benefit from mobility, defensive positioning, or specialized abilities. Learning the strengths and limitations of each character becomes an important part of mastering the game. The variety also improves replayability because different characters can significantly change how familiar encounters are approached.

The equipment and upgrade systems provide another compelling reason to continue exploring. With more than fifty passive items available, players can develop powerful combinations involving increased movement speed, enhanced damage, lifesteal, and other beneficial effects. These upgrades introduce considerable variety, allowing individual runs to evolve in unexpected directions. Permanent skill improvements also provide meaningful progression beyond individual attempts, ensuring that unsuccessful adventures can still contribute to future success. However, randomized item availability occasionally creates uneven difficulty, particularly when certain combinations prove substantially more effective than others.

Environmental variety contributes positively to the overall atmosphere. Dark dungeons, underground sewers, and imposing cathedrals establish a recognizable fantasy setting while offering different visual backgrounds for exploration. The colorful pixel-art presentation complements the game's arcade-inspired mechanics, giving characters and enemies distinctive appearances without relying on elaborate graphical technology. Although the environments are visually appealing, crowded encounters can sometimes become difficult to read when numerous enemies, projectiles, and combat effects overlap. This occasional visual clutter can make demanding battles feel more frustrating than necessary.

The soundtrack and sound effects reinforce the energetic atmosphere, providing suitable accompaniment to exploration and combat. Audio feedback helps communicate attacks and interactions, while the music supports the urgency of surviving hostile environments. The overall presentation prioritizes responsiveness and gameplay over cinematic storytelling, making it particularly suitable for players who value mechanical engagement. However, those seeking extensive dialogue, elaborate narratives, or complex world-building may find the experience relatively limited in these areas.

Replayability remains one of Dungeon Souls' greatest advantages. Procedural generation, character diversity, randomized equipment, and permanent upgrades create numerous opportunities for experimentation. The game also supports local cooperative multiplayer and Steam Remote Play Together, allowing players to tackle its challenges cooperatively. Additional features such as Steam achievements and trading cards provide supplementary incentives. Nevertheless, the repeated objective of activating marks and escaping through portals can eventually become repetitive, especially for players who prefer substantial changes in mission structure.

Steam Deck compatibility is officially categorized as Playable rather than fully Verified. Performance with the default graphics configuration is considered suitable, and the game can run successfully on SteamOS. However, handheld players should expect compromises. Some functionality is not fully accessible through the default controller configuration, touchscreen interaction or a community controller layout may occasionally be useful, and text entry can require manually opening the virtual keyboard. Some interface text may also appear small, while certain prompts can display keyboard, mouse, or non-Steam Deck controller icons. It is therefore functional on the Deck, but the experience is less seamless than a fully optimized handheld release.

Despite occasional balancing issues, repetitive objectives, and visually overwhelming encounters, Dungeon Souls succeeds in delivering an entertaining dungeon-crawling experience. Its combination of demanding combat, varied characters, rewarding upgrades, and unpredictable exploration creates an engaging gameplay loop that encourages repeated attempts. The game is particularly appealing to enthusiasts who enjoy overcoming difficult challenges through practice, experimentation, and gradual improvement. While it may not offer the refinement or complexity of the genre's most celebrated titles, its accessible mechanics and substantial replay value make it a worthwhile addition to an action roguelike collection.

A challenging and enjoyable pixel-art roguelike featuring energetic combat, meaningful character progression, diverse equipment combinations, and excellent replayability. Recommended for players who appreciate demanding dungeon crawlers and unpredictable adventures.

Rating: 7/10
